# A customer whose `guid:` is the word True, unquoted.
#
# The format reads an unquoted True as a truth value, not as text, so the
# block states no characters a guid could be read from.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the block.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_guid_that_is_not_text_is_refused.py.
customer "C-TRUE"
	name: "Guid Written As True"
	currency: CAD
	guid: True
